t: Integrating MCP: Giving My Local LLM App the Power to Act
s: The author is replacing Pipulate's homegrown tool-calling with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable local LLM applications to perform actions, addressing fragmentation in tool-calling specifications and aiming for a universal standard.
sub: Transitioning from homegrown tool-calling to the MCP protocol for LLM action execution.
Addressing MCP documentation gaps and vendor bias to enable Pipulate as an MCP client.
Exploring both HTTP and zero-HTTP MCP implementations for local LLM integration.
